method.rule: Adapt the upstream text; do not paraphrase it. Each local skill keeps the upstream structure, section names, leading words, and behavioural instructions, and edits only what the workflow changes: the tracker becomes the central bundle, the tracker operations become wfctl commands, and the review gates are named where upstream names a tracker label.
method.reviewNote: Revision 2ab9580 was recorded as 'derived' but was in practice a paraphrase: the conversational instructions were dropped while the artifacts and state machines were kept. This revision restores them from the upstream text.
